sources.label: Hydration referendum 367 HSM collateral consolidation, accessed 2026-10-09

reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-10-09 review of HOLLAR documentation confirms eligible borrower collateral and conditional HSM buybacks, while referendum 367 identifies an HSM-only historical allocation on 17 July 2026 and its planned consolidation into aUSDT/aUSDC. Neither disclosure establishes a current whole-liability collateral allocation across the borrower market, HSM and other facilitators. The existing 2026-10-01 token observation identified five facilitators; bucket levels measure liabilities, not backing weights. Retain 100% unresolved allocation and the original composition date. Conditional buybacks and yield strategies do not establish immediate whole-basket realization, so aggregate liquidity remains unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Classification-only unresolved HOLLAR backing; documented eligible collateral and historical HSM-only holdings do not establish current whole-book weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: A complete dated collateral and HSM-asset denominator is not established. Current facilitator bucket levels do not reveal per-asset reserve weights, HSM holdings, GIGAHDX/BIL collateral coverage, cross-venue debt, or double-counting adjustments.

providers.name: Hydration borrow-market and HOLLAR Stability Module contracts (non-custodial appchain positions)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held in on-chain borrow-market and HSM contracts on the Hydration appchain with automated per-block partial liquidations rather than a conventional custodian. Legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation concepts do not map to this non-custodial structure; operative risks are runtime governance and smart-contract integrity.
